name: user_attempts_multiple_requests_in_one_session
goal: User successfully requests an employment letter, then tries to request again in the same session.
constraints: Employee details must be present. User restarts the flow after completion.

phases.description: User completes a successful employment letter request.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays confirmation message and marks task as done.

phases.description: User initiates a new employment letter request in the same chat session.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot repeats the full flow and allows the second request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
